targets.query:
from(bucket: "ha_longterm")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id == "wh1_temperature" or r.entity_id == "wh1_probe_s3_temperature" or r.entity_id == "wh1_setpoint" or r.entity_id == "warehouse_cell_min_temperature" or r.entity_id == "warehouse_cell_max_temperature")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "ha_longterm")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_compressor" or r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_fan" or r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_hot_resistance" or r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_defrost_output" or r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_alarm_relay")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])
  |> yield(name: "states")

from(bucket: "ha_longterm")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id =~ /(_ema_temperature|meeting_room_temp|mensa_temp)$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "ha_longterm")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id =~ /(_valve_open_percent|_power_percent|^fancoil_demand_)/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "ha_longterm")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id == "outdoor_temperature" or r.entity_id == "outdoor_cloud_coverage" or r.entity_id == "shade_today_outdoor_max_forecast")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "ha_longterm")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id =~ /^shellypro4pm_ece334eaf568_switch_.*_power$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
